title: vb.experiment/1
description: An experiment manifest in experiments/, run by `vb campaign` (driver/campaign.py; S09 E5, E8): the experiment id every run gets, the order of its blocks, and its blocks, each one `vb run` cell. driver/campaign.py checks what the schema cannot state: ids, seeds, amounts, and the references to arms, streams, lines and the price snapshot.

id.description: The experiment id: `vb run --experiment` of every unit, and the directory under $VB_RESULTS.

prereg_id.description: The pre-registration's id, once the lock exists (3341); empty before.

requires_lock.description: The campaign may run only under the pre-registration lock (3341).

requires_live.description: Loops that must be LIVE at the harness sha (3359).

seed.description: daily_interleave: the key of each day's shuffle.

stream.description: A stream name in streams/, or a path.

planned_usd.description: The block's planned billed spend (S09 §3); required for a billed arm.

max_cost_usd.description: `vb run --max-cost-usd`; required for a network provider.

disturbance.description: A vb.disturbance/1 spec, relative to the benchmark's root.

instances.description: A subset of the stream's instances.

secret_fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the secret file the block's instances are audited under (S09 §4.1).

off_hours.description: Runs on a subscription shared with development, so off-hours.
